title: Narra 4.1.7
message: This release aligns the installed build version with the updater and improves Asian Drama browsing.
changelog: The installed app and update manifest now both report Narra 4.1.7, build 13.
Asian Drama see-all pages load additional source pages as you scroll.
Asian Drama playback uses landscape and restores the previous orientation when closed.
The profile update page and updater both read the installed BuildConfig version.
